title: Sayensị ịsa ihe na ụlọ ọrụ dị nchebe

say: Nnọọ na Sayensị Ịsa Ihe na Ụlọ Ọrụ Dị Nchebe, nkebi 1 nke usoro ọmụmụ a.
Tupu i gwakọta ihe ọ bụla, mụta ihe mere ngwaahịa ọ bụla ji arụ ọrụ, ihe dị n'ụlọ nkwakọ gị, na otu esi eme ka ụlọ a dị nchebe.

shots.label: Surfactant na-arụ ọrụ
say: Lee elu a nwere mmanụ. Naanị mmiri apụghị iwepụ mmanụ, n'ihi na mmanụ na mmiri anaghị agwakọ.
Spray a nwere surfactant, ihe nwere otu isi hụrụ mmiri n'anya na otu isi hụrụ mmanụ n'anya.
Ka anyị na-ehichapụ, mmanụ ahụ na-agbaji ghọọ obere ntapụ surfactant kechiri, ha esee pụọ.

shots.label: Akwụkwọ pH strip

card.title: Dabaa unyi na pH
card.note: Site na tebụl pH nke ọmụmụ

say: Lee ka strip ahụ na-agbanwe agba. Anyị na-atụnyere ya na chaatị.
pH, ọnụọgụ na-egosi ma ihe ọ bụ acid ma ọ bụ alkaline, na-amalite na 0 ruo 14. Mmiri dị ọcha bụ 7, neutral. N'okpuru 7 bụ acid, n'elu 7 bụ alkaline.
Mmanụ chọrọ alkaline. Okirikiri unyi toilet chọrọ acid. Nje chọrọ disinfectant mgbe a sachara ebe ahụ.

shots.label: Oge: ọ nọrọ tupu a saachapụ
say: Ị hụrụ timer na-aga ka elu ahụ ka dị mmiri mmiri? Oge bụ otu n'ime ike anọ nke ịsa ihe.
Ndị ọzọ bụ kemistri, omume dị ka ịkwọ, na okpomọkụ. Ọ bụrụ na otu agbadaa, nke ọzọ ga-arịrị elu.
Mgbe label toilet cleaner gị kwuru hapụ ya minit 10, oge na-arụ ọrụ ahụ.

shots.label: Bleach na ihe ịsa acid
shots.banner: Agwakọtala bleach na acid ma ọ bụ ammonia
say: Karama abụọ ndị a na-anọ iche: bleach n'otu akụkụ, toilet cleaner acid n'akụkụ nke ọzọ.
Bleach na acid na-ewepụta gas chlorine. Bleach na ammonia na-ewepụta gas chloramine dị egwu. Ha abụọ na-emebi anya na ngụgụ.

shots.label: Caustic soda (sodium hydroxide)
say: Ntụ a na-acha ọcha, dị ka mpekere, bụ caustic soda, nke ndị kemist na-akpọ sodium hydroxide. Ọ na-abịakwa dị ka pearls, obere mkpụrụ.
Ọ na-eme ka LABSA, acid sulphonic na-acha aja aja gbara ọchịchịrị, ihe dị ka pasentị 96 active, ghọọ surfactant bụ isi gị.
Ọ na-eri ihe, na-ere ahụ, ma na-ekpo ọkụ nke ukwuu n'ime mmiri.

shots.label: Ilele ihe e bugara
say: A na-etinye ihe ọ bụla e bugara n'elu scale. Bisi nke Ibadan na-atụ jerikan SLES pasentị 70 ya, nke ndị ahịa na-akpọ texapon.
Mgbe ọ juru eju, ọ dị 26.4 kilogram. Jerikan efu dị 1.4 kilogram, ya mere o nwere 25.0 kilogram.
Rịọ ndị na-ere ya safety data sheet na certificate of analysis. Enweghị akwụkwọ? Zụta ntakịrị ma dee na a maghị ike ya.

shots.label: Ebe nchekwa anọ
say: Lee shelf a. Ihe ọ bụla e ji debe ihe mechiri emechi ma nwee label, nwekwa ohere doro anya n'etiti otu na otu.
Acid na-anọkọ: LABSA na citric acid. Alkali na-anọkọ: caustic soda na soda ash. Bleach na-anọ naanị ya.
Isopropyl alcohol na isi ụtọ na-aga n'ebe nke anọ, ebe dị anya n'okpomọkụ, soket ọkụ na ọkụ ọ bụla.

shots.label: Mechiri emechi, n'elu ala
say: Lee ka mkpuchi na-akpọchi nke ọma. Caustic soda na-amịrị mmiri site n'ikuku ma kpụkọọ ọnụ, ya mere ntụ ga-anọ mechiri emechi ma ghara ịnọ n'ala.
Biko, ọ dịghị mgbe i ga-edebe ọgwụ ọ bụla na karama mmiri, karama minerals ma ọ bụ tọb nri. Ndị mmadụ aṅụọla ọgwụ ịsa ihe site na karama ha maara.

shots.label: Goggles, gloves, apron
say: Lee ihe nchebe gị: goggles mechiri emechi, gloves rọba siri ike na apron, ya na uwe aka ogologo na akpụkpọ ụkwụ kpuchiri ụkwụ.
Ugogbe anwụ agaghị egbochi ihe gbasara site n'akụkụ, a gaghịkwa enweta anya ọzọ.

shots.label: Ụlọ a haziri n'otu ụzọ
say: Tebụl ngwakọta a dị n'akụkụ windo mepere emepe, ka anwụrụ na uzuzu na-aga n'èzí.
Ihe na-aga n'otu ụzọ: ebe nchekwa, ịtụ ibu, ịgwakọta, izu ike na nnwale, ịwụnye, wee shelf ngwaahịa emechara.
Ọ dịghị onye na-ebughachi concentrate n'akụkụ onye na-awụnye karama, mmiri dị ọcha na-anọkwa n'akụkụ ebe ọ bụla ihe nwere ike ịgbasa.

shots.label: Caustic soda N'IME mmiri
say: Lee: mpekere ahụ na-abanye nwayọọ n'ime mmiri oyi, ntakịrị ntakịrị, ọ dịghị mgbe n'ụzọ ọzọ. Ị hụrụ ka okpomọkụ na-arị elu?
Jiri ihe plastik anaghị agbaze n'ọkụ, ọ dịghị mgbe aluminium, n'ihi na caustic soda na-eri ya.
LABSA na-abanyekwa n'ime mmiri, ka a na-akpali. Dee label na bọket ọ bụla, ọbụna ma ọ bụ naanị maka otu awa.

shots.label: Mmiri na-asọ na ịsa anya
shots.banner: Saa anya na akpụkpọ ahụ ọ dịkarịa ala minit 15
say: Ọ bụrụ na ihe gbabara gị n'anya, saa ya n'okpuru mmiri dị ọcha na-asọ nwayọọ ọ dịkarịa ala minit 15, jide nkpuchi anya ka ọ ghere oghe.
N'akpụkpọ ahụ, yipụ uwe mmiri gbara ma saa ya otu ụzọ ahụ. Ejila vinegar mee ka ihe gbasara ghara ike.
Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ loro ngwaahịa, emela ka ọ gbọọ agbọ. Saachapụ ọnụ ya ma chọọ enyemaka dọkịta ozugbo, ya na label ahụ.
Ugbu a ị maara ihe mere ngwaahịa ji asa ihe, otu esi edebe ihe eji arụ ọrụ gị, na otu esi echekwa onwe gị.
Gụọ ihe ọmụmụ ndị dị n'okpuru, wee mee ọrụ omume: maapụ unyi gị, ndepụta ihe eji arụ ọrụ gị na foto ebe nchekwa gị.
